editorial:
Imagine being stuck on a platform 50 floors up in the air while a group of scary activists takes over the building behind you. That is exactly where you find our main character, an ex-soldier who now cleans windows for a living. She is trapped on the outside of the glass, but she is the only person who can save 300 hostages, including her own brother. The vibe is super intense from the start, making you feel the height and the danger as she uses her old military skills to fight back from the most awkward position possible. It is a wild ride that turns a boring job into a high-stakes rescue mission.

The action is the best part here because it feels real and keeps you on the edge of your seat. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the bad guys feel a bit like stereotypes. If you love movies where one person takes on a whole army, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the window cleaner uses her gear to swing into the building and take out the leader of the activists. She manages to rescue her brother just as the police breach the room. The big twist reveals that the energy company was actually hiding some dirty secrets that the activists found. While the bad guys are arrested, the company's reputation is ruined, and she finally quits her job to start something new.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes action and underdog stories.
